text:
Leah: Heads-up: launch week plan — we want a 48-hour amplify window around the webinar with targeted seeding + two follow-up touchpoints. Need copy variations, assets, and routing. Who can own end-to-end?
Tom: I'll own scheduling and initial monitoring. Planning to run native X scheduling + LinkedIn carousel via Sprout. Will pin two replies and export mentions to a daily digest.
Priya: Copy approach: 3 hooks per platform (dev-first, cost-savings, benchmark). We'll run lightweight A/B: headline test on X and carousel order test on LinkedIn. Primary CTA -> webinar RSVP; secondary -> benchmark post.
Megan: Design can produce: 3-slide LinkedIn carousel, 1200x675 hero card for feed, and a short 9:16 clip for stories. Can also make a simplified benchmark PNG for thread slide 2. Need copy by Tue noon PT.
LeadsOps: Routing note: tag leads with campaign = "Amplify_Launch_May" and source = social. We'll auto-create the lead and add to queue `sdr-amplify`. Tag high-intent replies (words: "pricing", "demo", "trial") for immediate alerts.
Leah: Timing plan (UTC):
```
2026-05-20,07:45,linkedin,carousel,carousel-1
2026-05-20,07:50,x,headline,hero-card
2026-05-20,08:30,x,thread-start,thread-1
2026-05-21,09:00,x,followup,reply-1
2026-05-21,13:00,linkedin,boost,card-boost
```
Tom: I'll keep the X thread live for 72h and pin the two templated replies for 48h. Will schedule a boosted post to target developer audiences with job titles: ML Engineer, Platform Engineer.
Priya: Draft copy snippets (first pass):
- Dev hook (X headline): "Ship LLM features with predictable latency and half the infra cost. Join our launch webinar -> https://redwood.ai/webinar"
- Benchmark hook (X headline): "Benchmarks: 20-40% token cost reduction at 95th pct latency. Live walkthrough in our webinar.
"
- Thread opener: "We focused on runtime telemetry, smarter batching, and quantization paths. Thread: what changed and how it helps teams \u2193"
Megan: Asset specs: carousel slides 1080x1080; hero 1200x675; story clip 1080x1920; benchmark PNG 1200x900. Include alt-text for each asset.
LeadsOps: Confirm Zap mapping: we'll send thread_ts and lead_id in description so marketing can trace origin. Also recommend adding utm_source and utm_campaign: utm_source=x|linkedin, utm_campaign=amplify_launch_may, utm_medium=social. Use bit.ly shorten.
Leah: Engagement follow-up templates (pick two):
1) "Thanks! We'll cover latency & cost tradeoffs in the webinar — grab a seat: https://redwood.ai/webinar"
2) "Quick benchmark snapshot here: https://redwood.ai/benchmarks — happy to DM the full CSV if you'd like deeper numbers."
Tom: I'll set the pinned replies and wire a Zap to DM the SDR rota when replies include high-intent keywords. Also will export top reply threads every morning to the #sdr-amplify channel.
Priya: Measurement: CTR to webinar, replies with intent, retweets, and LinkedIn engagement. We'll track UTM params in GA and funnel to SFDC campaign. Aim: 250 webinar signups from social window, 40 MQLs.
Megan: Need brand-approved logo and preferred alt-text phrasing. @Leah can you drop the approved files in #assets by EOD?
Leah: Dropping logo + brand alt guidelines now. Also uploading preliminary benchmark numbers for the PNG.
Tom: Action list:
- Priya: final copy variants by Tue 12pm PT
- Megan: assets + alt-text by Tue 6pm PT
- Tom: schedule + pinned replies + Zap wiring by Wed 9am PT
- LeadsOps: confirm SFDC mapping and SDR rota by Wed 5pm PT
Priya: Will post copy variations in this thread for quick review.
Megan: I'll include an accessibility checklist when I upload images.
postbot: Scheduled 5 social items across platforms. Next scheduled run: 2026-05-20 07:45 UTC.
Leah: Perfect. Quick check-in Wed 10am PT for pre-launch validation. :calendar:
